semantics.guides: Stable UUID/name/H/V axis/finite absolute canvas coordinate.1024 max, bounded list pages1..64. Duplicate names require id; edits/cancellation/resource/lock failures atomic. Same update and empty clear have no history. Lines are canvas references, remain fixed during image geometry and never export into pixels.
semantics.project: Manifest9 only with nonempty guides. Empty data follows prior8/7/6 rules. Old projects default empty; old version cannot claim guides. Real file/recovery/undo preserve ids and fractional coordinates with exact JSON float parsing.
semantics.presentation: Editor-local rulers/guides visibility, guide lock and snap enable/tolerance/artboard plus monotonic version. Same value does not advance version; never document history/revision/dirty/current-layer. Changes revoke older guide/snap ownership.
semantics.snapping: Nearest independent X/Y reference to raw content edges/center; guide-before-artboard, lower coordinate, edge-before-center, stable-id tie ordering. Integer layer storage rounds half away from zero; exact returned anchor and signed residual document fractional mismatch. Preserve source/tile versions/masks/kind/IDs/tree/ICC/depth. Hidden children do not disclose bounds but move with subtree. Source origin/content bounds must be within +/-1e12;64M visits and measured child areas. Adjustments alone have no finite content box; blank ink rejects.
semantics.preview: Original source extent measured once off editor/render lock and cached only in trusted request. Native V and numeric UI use layer.snap_position; shared bounded display preview does not write drag history. Metadata-only guide edits/undo never prepare image rendering. Presentation version, document/revision/active-layer/control epoch and per-operation cancellation protect late results.
semantics.pointer: Ruler drags and V-tool existing-line drags stage only overlays. Original guide request/target/epoch lives in the same operation-bound native geometry slot as crop/transform, not model parameters. Release once through add/update; Escape/context/tool changes cancel. Guide/position apply returns focus to canvas for document undo.
